The Lean theorem must expose these as hypotheses and may not claim the polynomial certificates establish them. Independent QA checks semantic correspondence; known-false control drops kernel condition and must fail using a noninjective map between a two-element space and a singleton. Formal runtime dependency pins are absent and are a concrete activation prerequisite.
formal_target.representation: Lean core Setoid/Quotient model: type Z with declared explained equivalence E, target type T with declared equivalence Tmem, and pi. Hypotheses state surjectivity modulo Tmem and that pi(z1)~pi(z2) iff z1~E z2. Prove induced quotient map is well-defined, injective and surjective, retaining exact hypotheses. Polynomial linear-map/kernel/intersection premises are independently certified, not proved by this abstract lemma.
